Fubini, Google Books 1hpdAAAAMAAJ, old interface in Chrome) for 'XLVIII, 11' ... 'XLVIII, 15' and 'Soderini luglio 1477': its notes and Rochon, La jeunesse de Laurent (1963), which uses Soderini's 1477 letters in MAP XLVIII without mention of cipher, would show whether the text was read as ordinary prose. Antonio di Bernardo et ... Pandolfo mio'); 189, the lower half of the recto is a decipherment in another hand ('Adi xiii ti scripsi ... questo poco della cifra non credo sia mal usare ...'); 191, c. 197r is the clear text of c. 196r and its postscript ('... valersene nel parmigiano essendo ricaduto nel male ...', 'Dicte a Pandolfo che potrebbe essere ...'); 196, a clear line in a chancery hand under the cipher postscript ('Conforterei lo assicurarsi delle assegnationi innanzi che si sborsassi el danaro'); 199v, a clear line under the postscript ('Comando che in campo non sia ordine a fare obedienza'). 158 (c. 161r, 'Copia d'uno capitolo di lettera ... 19 di dicembre 1482', three cipher lines in the ## sign family of catalogue 2309) has a two-line clear slip filed with it as c. 162r ('non credo che la S. 2378.unvetted: tiny, and printed in an edition not opened. The six code signs (a box with a cross-stroke twice, a cross, 'B', a triangle with 'v', a circled cross) are single symbols about 25-40 px high on a 1272-px page (line height about 45 px), in a clear 30-line copy in Lorenzo's hand headed 'Abram'. The letter is in the Protocolli (Del Piazzo 1956: 'di L. all'Ugolini, 1486 agosto 20, M. a P., LXXII, 403'), the Censimento (1964) and is printed in Lorenzo's Lettere IX (1485-1486, ed. Butters 2002, Google Books cSFdAAAAMAAJ; the feed shows its contents line 'A BACCIO UGOLINI, 20 AGOSTO 1486'). Needed: the Lettere IX page in Chrome (old interface, search inside 'Abram', 'LXXII, 403', 'segno') to see whether the editor resolves the signs (the key sheet 'Cifra col Baccio Ugolini' is LXXII 181). If resolved, close as read; if printed unresolved, six person signs are too slight for a catalogue entry and the lead is a key lookup on LXXII 181.

2379.unvetted: the printed Lettere not opened. The minute is a registered letter of Lorenzo to Giovanni Lanfredini: the Protocolli (Del Piazzo 1956) list it at 'M. a P., CXXXVII, 504' just before the letter of 27 Apr 1489, the Censimento (1964) places 'MAP, CXXXVII, 504' among the Lanfredini letters of November 1488, and Lettere XV (marzo-agosto 1489, ed. Boninger, Google Books oSQsAQAAMAAJ / JgcwAQAAMAAJ) cites it in its notes to the letter to Lanfredini of 28 Mar 1489 ('il testo di due suppliche riguardanti la costruzione e dotazione del convento fiorentino di San Gallo (MAP, CXXXVII, 504; cfr. Kent, Lorenzo de' Medici, pp. 97-99)'). Its text (answering Lanfredini's letters of the 11th and 13th on Perugia, the Baglioni and the Oddi, 'N.S.') belongs in Lettere XIV or XV, whose editors print Lorenzo's cipher passages from deciphered or register copies where they survive. Needed: Chrome search inside the Lettere volume for Oct 1488 - Feb 1489 and vol. XV for 'CXXXVII, 504' and 'Oddi', to see whether the letter is printed and whether its ~14 cipher runs are given in clear. The Lanfredini Naples edition (Corrispondenza degli ambasciatori fiorentini a Napoli, 1484-1487) ends before this letter. Everything else checked: see notes.
